info.title: Portalu API
info.description:
Portalu lets organisations create customer-facing service portals.
Staff sign up, build portals, define request types, and process incoming requests.
Customers sign up to a portal, submit requests, and track their progress.

## Authentication

Two independent token families:

| Scheme | Who | How to obtain |
|---|---|---|
| **StaffBearer** | Org staff / admins | `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in` |
| **CustomerBearer** | Portal customers | `POST /api/v1/customer/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/sign-in` |

Endpoints marked 🔓 require no token.

## Permissions

Staff endpoints require specific permission keys on the caller's role.
The required permission is noted in each operation description.
Fetch the full list from `GET /api/v1/org/permissions` (org-level) or `GET /api/v1/org/portals/permissions` (portal-level).

post.description: Creates a new organization and the founding Super Admin user in a single call. The user receives a verification email — they cannot sign in until the email is confirmed.
Consumes the token from the verification email link and marks the user's email as verified. Tokens expire after 24 hours and can only be used once.
Sends a new verification email to the given address. Silently succeeds if the email is not found to prevent enumeration.
Authenticates a staff user and returns a short-lived `access_token` (JWT) and a long-lived `refresh_token`. Use the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

403.description: Account deactivated or email not verified

423.description: Account locked due to too many failed login attempts

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair. The old refresh token is invalidated on use.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired, or already used

post.description: Invalidates the provided refresh token. The access token continues to work until it expires (up to 30 minutes) — clients should discard it immediately.
Sends a password reset link to the given email address. Always returns the same response regardless of whether the email exists, to prevent enumeration.
Consumes the token from the reset email and sets a new password. Also invalidates all existing refresh tokens for the user. Tokens expire after 1 hour.
Consumes an invitation token, sets the user's password, and returns auth tokens. The user is immediately signed in after accepting. Tokens expire after 7 days.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile including their org and portal role assignments.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's name. Email changes are not supported via this endpoint.

get.description: Returns the organization the authenticated user belongs to.

patch.description: Updates the organization's name or slug. Requires `org.users.manage`. Changing the slug will break existing portal URLs — use with caution.

get.description: Returns the organization's security configuration including lockout policy, MFA settings, and customer identity scope.

patch.description: Updates one or more security settings. All fields are optional — only provided fields are changed. Requires `org.users.manage`.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all users in the organization.

post.description: Creates a user account and sends them an invitation email with a link to set their password. Requires `org.users.manage`.

409.description: Email address already registered in this org

get.description: Returns the profile of a specific org user including their role assignments.

patch.description: Updates a user's name or status. Set `status` to `'inactive'` to disable their access. Requires `org.users.manage`.

post.description: Sets the user's status to `inactive`, immediately blocking their access. Requires `org.users.manage`.

get.description: Returns all roles assigned to the user across the org and all portals.

schema.title: Response List User Roles Api V1 Org Users  User Id  Roles Get

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description: Assigns an org-level role to the user. Use `POST /org/portals/{portal_id}/users` to assign portal-scoped roles. Requires `org.users.manage`.

409.description: Role already assigned to this user

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description: Removes an org-level role assignment from a user. Requires `org.users.manage`.

get.description: Returns all roles defined in the organization, including both org-level and portal-level roles.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Org Roles Get

post.description: Creates a new role with a set of permissions. Set `level` to `'portal'` for roles that will be assigned at the portal level — portal-level roles only accept portal permission keys. Requires `org.users.manage`.

422.description: Invalid permission keys or level mismatch

get.description: Returns a single role by ID.

patch.description: Updates a role's name, description, or permissions. The `permissions` field **replaces** the full permission set — send the complete list you want, not a diff. Requires `org.users.manage`.

422.description: Invalid permission keys or level mismatch

delete.description: Deletes a role and removes all assignments of that role from users and portals. Requires `org.users.manage`.

get.description: Returns all available org-level permission keys with labels and descriptions. Use this to populate a permissions picker when creating or editing roles. Only permission keys from this list are valid for org-level roles.
Returns all departments in the organization with their member count.

schema.title: Response List Departments Api V1 Org Departments Get

post.description: Creates a new department in the organization. Requires `org.departments.manage`.

get.description: Returns a department with its full member list.

patch.description: Updates a department's name or description. Requires `org.departments.manage`.

delete.description: Deletes a department and removes all its members. Requires `org.departments.manage`.

post.description: Adds an org user to the department. Requires `org.departments.manage`.

409.description: User is already a member of this department

delete.description: Removes a user from the department. Requires `org.departments.manage`.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of invitations that have not yet been accepted.

post.description: Sends a new invitation email for an existing pending invitation. Requires `org.users.manage`.
Cancels a pending invitation so the token in the email can no longer be used. Requires `org.users.manage`.

get.description: Returns all active sessions for the current user. Pass `X-Session-ID` header or `session_id` query param to mark the current session with `is_current: true`.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

delete.description: Invalidates all active sessions for the current user, signing them out of every device.
Invalidates a single session by ID. Silently succeeds if the session does not exist or belongs to another user.

get.description: Returns all requests in the organization. Requires `requests:read`.

schema.title: Response List Requests Api V1 Org Requests Get

post.description: Creates a new org-level request. Requires `requests:create`.

patch.description: Updates a request's title or status. Requires `requests:update`.

get.description: Returns all available portal-level permission keys with labels and descriptions. Use this to populate a permissions picker when creating portal-scoped roles. Only permission keys from this list are valid for portal-level roles.
Returns all portals in the organization.

schema.title: Response List Portals Api V1 Org Portals Get

post.description: Creates a new customer-facing portal. The slug must be unique within the org and is used in all portal URLs. If not provided it is auto-generated from the name. Requires `org.users.manage`.

409.description: Slug already in use within this org

patch.description: Updates the portal's name, description, slug, or domain. Requires `portal.settings:manage`.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a portal and all associated request types, requests, and workflow data. Requires `org.users.manage`.

post.description: Assigns an org user to a portal with a specific portal-level role. The role must have `level: 'portal'`. Requires `portal.users:manage`.

422.description: Role level mismatch — role must be portal-scoped

delete.description: Removes a user's portal-level role assignment. The user retains their org-level roles. Requires `portal.users:manage`.

get.description: Returns all request types defined on the portal, including their custom fields. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

schema.title: Response List Request Types Api V1 Org Portals  Portal Id  Request Types Get

post.description: Creates a new service type customers can apply for on this portal. Add fields with `POST /{portal_id}/request-types/{request_type_id}/fields`. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

patch.description: Updates the name or description of a request type. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

delete.description: Deletes a request type and its fields. Existing customer requests of this type are not deleted. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

get.description: Returns all custom fields for a request type, ordered by `order`. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

schema.title: Response List Request Type Fields Api V1 Org Portals  Portal Id  Request Types  Request Type Id  Fields Get

post.description: Adds a custom input field to a request type. For `field_type: 'select'`, `options` is required. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

patch.description: Updates a field's label, type, options, or order. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

delete.description: Removes a field from the request type. Does not affect previously submitted field values. Requires `portal.request_types:manage`.

get.description: Returns requests submitted on this portal. With `portal.requests:read` only returns requests where the caller has an assigned task. With `portal.requests:read_all` returns all requests. Supports filtering by `status`, `request_type_id`, `assigned_to_me`, `from_date`, and `to_date`.

schema.title: Response List Portal Requests Api V1 Org Portals  Portal Id  Requests Get

get.description: Returns a single request with its field values. Requires `portal.requests:read` (own tasks) or `portal.requests:read_all`.

patch.description: Updates the status or title of a request. Requires `portal.requests:update`.

get.summary: Get signed URL for a file field
get.description: Generates a temporary signed URL (valid 1 hour) for a `file` field on a request. Requires `portal.requests:read` or `portal.requests:read_all`.
Returns the workflow definition for a request type, including all task definitions and their dependencies. Requires `portal.workflows:view`.

put.description: Replaces the entire workflow for a request type. This is a full replacement — send all task definitions you want to keep. Task `key` values must be unique within the workflow. Requires `portal.workflows:manage`.

get.description: Returns all workflow task instances for a request, including their status, assignee, and comments. Requires `portal.requests:read`.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api V1 Org Portals  Portal Id  Requests  Request Id  Tasks Get

get.description: Returns a single task instance with its definition, status, and comments. Requires `portal.requests:read`.

patch.description: Updates the assignee of a task instance. Requires `portal.requests:update`.

post.description: Marks a task as complete with an outcome (`approved`, `rejected`, or `clarification_requested`). Completing a task may activate downstream tasks in the workflow. Requires `portal.requests:update`.
Adds a comment to a task instance. At least one of `body` or `file_url` must be provided. Requires `portal.requests:update`.

get.description: Returns all comments on a task instance, ordered by creation time. Requires `portal.requests:read`.

schema.title: Response List Task Comments Api V1 Org Portals  Portal Id  Requests  Request Id  Tasks  Task Id  Comments Get

get.description: Returns the public-facing name, slug, and description of the portal. Use this to render a branded landing page. No authentication required.

post.description: Creates a customer account scoped to this org. The customer receives a verification email — they cannot sign in until the email is confirmed. If `redirect_url` is provided the verification link is built as `{redirect_url}?token=...`.

409.description: Email already registered on this portal's org

post.description: Consumes the verification token from the email link and marks the account as verified. Tokens expire after 24 hours and can only be used once.
Authenticates a customer and returns a portal-scoped `access_token` and `refresh_token`. The access token is valid for 30 minutes. The same credentials work on any portal in this org.

403.description: Account deactivated, email not verified, or account locked

423.description: Account locked due to too many failed login attempts

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair scoped to this portal. The old refresh token is invalidated on use.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired, or already used

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token from **any portal in the same org** for a new token scoped to this portal. Use this to silently sign a customer into a second portal without re-authentication. The customer must belong to the same org as the target portal. Store the refresh token keyed by `org_slug` (not portal) so it is reusable across portals.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired, or already used

403.description: Token belongs to a different org

post.description: Invalidates the provided refresh token. The access token remains valid until it expires.
Sends a password reset link to the customer's email. Always returns the same response regardless of whether the email exists.
Consumes the reset token and sets a new password. Also invalidates all existing refresh tokens for the customer. Tokens expire after 1 hour.

get.description: Returns the authenticated customer's profile.
Returns the request types customers can apply for on this portal, including their custom fields. No authentication required — use this to render the service catalogue before sign-in.

schema.title: Response List Request Types Api V1 Customer  Org Slug   Portal Slug  Request Types Get

get.description: Returns all requests submitted by the authenticated customer on this portal. Optionally filter by `status`.

schema.title: Response List My Requests Api V1 Customer  Org Slug   Portal Slug  Requests Get

post.description: Submits a new request of the given type with optional field values. The `request_type_id` must belong to this portal.

get.description: Returns a single request submitted by the authenticated customer. Returns 404 if the request belongs to a different customer.

post.description: Uploads a file (PDF, JPEG, PNG — max 10 MB) and returns a `storage_path` to be passed as the value of a `file` field when submitting a request.

get.summary: Get signed URL for a file field
get.description: Generates a temporary signed URL (valid 1 hour) for a `file` field on the citizen's own request.
